ThingDef.label: solar lmg
ThingDef.description: A light machine gun produced by the Solar Republics for sustained suppressive fire. Durable, hard-hitting, and exceptionally reliable under prolonged combat stress, this platform outperforms most ultratech-standard squad automatics.

ThingDef.label: solar pistol
ThingDef.description: A simple blowback-operated self-loading pistol. Quick to fire with reasonable accuracy, but at the cost of damage and armor penetration.\n\nThis weapon is commonly used by petty criminals within Solar Republics, but can otherwise be found throughout the stars wielded by Crime-Lords or high-end Enforcers

ThingDef.label: solar chain shotgun
ThingDef.description: A drum-fed fully automatic shotgun, less precise with a shorter effective range than standard models. Oftentimes battles fought between the squabbling Solar Republics have so many warriors doing battle that accuracy is far less important than capacity and rate of fire.

ThingDef.label: solar assault rifle
ThingDef.description: A general-purpose rifle often issued to Rank-and-File soldiers within Solar Republics, the weapon is moderately effective at all ranges and comes with a built-in holographic 'flip-up' sight. The design has been attributed to a number of Republics, though none of which can verify their claims to its manufacture.

ThingDef.label: solar sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: A bolt-action 'rifle' which launches shards of Sunsteel at whatever sorry fool the weapon is pointed toward. While having exceptional range, accuracy, and power, the multi-zoom thermal scope cannot be removed and conventional ironsights are not present, causing other weapons to outclass it at close range.

ThingDef.label: solar gauss pistol
ThingDef.description: Refined Solarite integration enables electromagnetic acceleration of Sunsteel rounds to devastating effect. The Solar Republics' counter-mechanoid specialists relied on this compact pistol to supplement their arsenal, its superior kickback management allowing sustained fire despite the weapon's formidable power output.

ThingDef.label: solar gauss shotgun
ThingDef.description: A compact electromagnetic shotgun engineered by the Solar Republics for intense close-quarters counter-mechanoid engagements. Solarite reinforcement allows the weapon's frame to withstand the immense recoil forces from its unique fragmented projectile design, making it devastating in the hands of well-trained specialists.

ThingDef.label: solar gauss rifle
ThingDef.description: A versatile electromagnetic rifle utilizing Solar Republics' breakthrough in Solarite-enhanced weapon design. Built specifically for counter-mechanoid operations, the rifle's refined recoil distribution allows even moderately-trained soldiers to maintain accurate sustained fire when facing hostile synthetic threats.

ThingDef.label: solar gauss dmr
ThingDef.description: A designated marksman rifle developed by the Solar Republics for counter-mechanoid specialists. Solarite integration provides exceptional accuracy and stopping power against synthetic targets, while the weapon's recoil compensation system allows sustained rapid fire without degrading accuracy.

ThingDef.label: solar gauss bullpup
ThingDef.description: A compact yet powerful electromagnetic rifle built for close-quarters counter-mechanoid operations. The Solarite-enhanced frame absorbs the intense recoil forces generated by the gauss accelerator, enabling effective suppressive fire in confined spaces where Solar Republic anti-synthetics teams operate.

ThingDef.label: solar gauss sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: The pinnacle of Solar Republic counter-mechanoid firepower. This precision electromagnetic rifle features Solarite reinforcement throughout its frame to withstand the immense stresses of electromagnetic acceleration. Deployed by elite anti-synthetic specialists, it delivers devastating firepower at extreme range with minimal recoil.

ThingDef.label: solar gauss cannon
ThingDef.description: A rapid-fire electromagnetic cannon developed by the Solar Republics as the ultimate counter-mechanoid suppressive weapon. Solarite reinforcement allows sustained burst fire without structural degradation, and the weapon's recoil management system enables accurate fire despite its devastating power.

ThingDef.label: solar beam pistol
ThingDef.description: A compact Solar Republic beam sidearm engineered for shipboard security operations. Its sealed electromagnetic emitter generates zero atmospheric discharge, making it ideal for operations within vacuum-sealed spacecraft. Developed during early Solar Republic counter-mechanoid campaigns, it delivers reliable close-range performance without risk of hull breach.

ThingDef.label: solar beam rifle
ThingDef.description: A standard-issue Solar Republic beam rifle, designed from the ground up for space assault operations. The laser emitter produces no chemical propellant byproducts, making this weapon perfectly safe aboard vacuum-sealed spacecraft and space stations. Widely deployed by Solar Republic boarding parties against mechanoid threats in orbital combat.

ThingDef.label: solar beam scatter
ThingDef.description: A close-quarters Solar Republic beam scatter weapon designed for corridor fighting aboard spacecraft and orbital facilities. Its modified prism scatters the beam into multiple overlapping pulses, providing devastating close-range coverage without risk to spacecraft hull integrity. Engineered specifically for anti-mechanoid suppression in confined vacuum environments.

ThingDef.label: solar beam dmr
ThingDef.description: A precision Solar Republic beam designated marksman rifle, used by specialist units conducting anti-mechanoid operations in the void of space. Its tight beam focus allows for accurate semi-automatic fire without producing any recoil or atmospheric discharge, making it exceptionally effective aboard space installations where conventional firearms would pose serious risks.

ThingDef.label: solar beam bullpup
ThingDef.description: A compact Solar Republic close-quarters beam weapon designed for rapid anti-mechanoid clearance in confined spacecraft compartments. The bullpup configuration minimizes length without sacrificing beam path, allowing effective suppressive fire in tight corridors and airlocks. Engineered for space combat, its sealed emitter produces no atmospheric discharge, preventing hull damage during interior operations.

ThingDef.label: solar beam lmg
ThingDef.description: A heavy-duty Solar Republic beam repeater designed as a sustained fire platform for anti-mechanoid operations in space. Its high-capacity focusing arrays deliver continuous bursts of coherent energy without fouling or recoil, ideal for prolonged engagements within spacecraft corridors. The complete absence of combustion products makes it safe to operate in fully vacuum-sealed environments.

ThingDef.label: solar beam sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: The most powerful precision beam weapon produced by the Solar Republics for vacuum operations. Its advanced optical focusing array delivers devastating energy at extreme ranges, originally developed to eliminate mechanoid threats before they could breach spacecraft hulls. The weapon's complete absence of chemical propulsion makes it uniquely suited to sealed space environments.
